master.prompt: Burnt orange highway tractor with marker lights and wide mirrors coupled to a plain box freight semi-trailer. Polished paint with road dust. Exactly FOUR axles TOTAL: TWO tractor axles (one steering, one drive), TWO trailer axles at far left. Identical 1.00m highway rib tread road tires and silver hubs on ALL axles. Whole tractor AND trailer in one image. strictly flat 2D side profile, camera perpendicular to the near side at hub height, no perspective, all tires the same size on one level line, no far-side tires. Premium semi-realistic painted game illustration matching approved Swamp Scout. Readable dark contours, richly textured weathered materials and fine mechanical detail, soft even daylight. Facing RIGHT, cab front face NOT visible, only sliver of roof. True alpha transparent background with clean neutral edges, NO coloured fringe, halo, checkerboard, ground, shadow, text, logos or watermark. Every near-side tire fully visible, perfectly circular with centred rim, hub centres horizontal and bottoms level. Chassis/deck/load horizontal. Full object with generous 5% clear margins on all sides. Very wide 3000x1000 composition. Orthographic side elevation, FOUR road wheels clearly visible: 2 at left trailer, 1 tractor rear drive, 1 front steering at right.

body.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target interstate-1 vehicle-master-v1.png, original canvas EXACTLY 2296x883 pixels. Remove ALL FOUR road wheels: two under left box trailer, one behind tractor cab, one front at right; retain entire white box trailer and orange cab. Remove every road tire and rim, including all far-side rubber. Replace each tire's UPPER semicircle with an OPAQUE painted wheel-well interior from the fender lip DOWN TO THE ORIGINAL HUB-CENTRE HORIZONTAL LINE, full arch width: dark solid inner fender liner with chassis rails, small axle housings, leaf springs, shocks, air lines and mud flaps, matching original truck style. Fill the gaps between tandem or triple arches above hub line with dark chassis/suspension. Absolutely NO transparent sky holes in any arch above hub line even with a separately animated tire dropped a third radius. Below hub line leave the lower half of every removed tire circle transparent; open ground clearance below chassis stays transparent. No tires, rims, circular wheel discs, black full-circle silhouettes or ghosts. Change NOTHING outside wheel regions. Cab, body, load, spare, equipment and all details stay exactly registered to original master pixels. Preserve canvas dimensions, body position, scale, camera and original clear margins. strictly flat 2D side profile, camera perpendicular to the near side at hub height, no perspective, all tires the same size on one level line, no far-side tires. Premium semi-realistic painted game illustration with soft even light. True alpha transparent background, no checkerboard, halo, ground, cast shadow, added text or watermark. Return edited image only at the EXACT original dimensions.
